items.title: Jones Hank — Smithsonian Jazz Oral History
items.q: Ray left the group in 1948 to form his own trio. That was comprised of Hank Jones and Charlie Smith on drums. [INTERVIEWEE] That’s right!

ctx.x: Charlie Smith… I think the one clip of Charlie Parker that exists, Charlie Smith is in it. It's on a TV show.
I have a picture somewhere of Charlie, and Ray and I. Tad Damron is in the picture I think.
Do you remember what the occasion was?
